label: Trades & Home Services
description: Audit framework for plumbers, electricians, HVAC, roofers, and similar trade businesses.
auditFocus: Service agreement and maintenance plan conversion
voicePromptHints: Ask how inbound calls are handled after hours.
Ask what percentage of service calls result in a membership or maintenance plan offer.
Ask how they currently request Google reviews from happy customers.
Ask what their booking-to-job completion rate looks like.
Ask how they handle callbacks or warranty issues.
